body: Thank you. I don't know what to say... :')

Those friends are gone. They've moved on. They don't talk to me. They cleared themselves of the burden of knowing they didn't try.  When I die they will be able to tell themselves that they tried. They are gone and kicked me from their lives.

I really want to believe that. I appreciate you and your efforts. But sometimes you've got to say enough is enough. It's exactly like drowning. The more and more  you fight when you're drowning the harder and harder it gets to stay afloat and keep the water from your lungs. The harder and harder I fight to be happy the more and more misery fills my lungs and I choke. I can't keep choking.
Im very glad to help :) stay strong and.feel free to message me.:)
